verdict.rationale: Docs confirm webhooks fire on any Persona resource event and can notify on lifecycle changes like approved/declined/requires review, with signed/authenticated deliveries (OAuth 2.0 client credentials mentioned). However, no explicit evidence names the specific 'created', 'processing', 'verified', 'requires-input' event types or confirms HMAC/signature verification mechanics in detail, and docs also mention polling as an alternative pattern rather than exclusively event-driven. Missing for 10: explicit list of inquiry/verification lifecycle event names, concrete signature-verification (signing secret/HMAC) documentation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of delivery reliability.
